title.en: An Act Providing for the Payment of the Life Insurance Policies Issued By the Government Insurance System and Appropriating Funds therefor.

text.en:
Each and every life insurance policy issued by the Government Service Insurance System to its
members which was in force as of December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and forty-one, is hereby considered
and declared in force notwithstanding the nonpayment of premiums, and any policy which matured by death
or otherwise shall become payable to the insured or his beneficiaries: Provided, That all premiums, interests
and other obligations due and payable to the Government Service Insurance System shall be collected: And
provided, further, That in the case of an optional policy or of a membership policy the continuance of which is
no longer compulsory, the policy shall not continue in force after the expiration of sixty days from the date of
the approval of this Act, unless it has sufficient cash value or the insured pays at least the amounts necessary
to continue said policy in accordance with the provisions thereof and/or the regulations of the Government
Service Insurance Board.

To carry out the purposes of this Act, there is appropriated out of any funds in the National
Treasury not otherwise appropriated for other purposes, the sum of four million pesos.

The funds herein appropriated shall not be released unless and until the Secretary of Finance and
the Auditor General shall have certified to the President that there are existing and available funds in the
National Treasury in excess of the sums appropriated in the General Appropriation Law for the fiscal year
ending June thirtieth , nineteen hundred and forty-six, and the priority appropriations established by law:
Provided, That the President may order the release in full or in installments of the funds herein authorized as
the Secretary of Finance and the Auditor General may certify to their existence and availability.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 1, 1945.
